title: Prophylactic Treatment of Hepatic Dysplastic Nodules in HBsAg Positive Patients
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to determine that for hepatic dysplastic nodules in patients with chronic hepatitis B, instead of enhanced follow-up, whether early minimally-invasive ablation therapy can reduce the incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with chronic HBV
* Diagnosis of hepatic dysplastic nodule(s) be confirmed by biopsy.

Exclusion Criteria:

* concurrent HCV infection
